)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clinical_assessment" (
  "assessed_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "assessment" text NOT NULL,
  "assessment_id" uuid NOT NULL,

)

  PRIMARY KEY ("dispensing_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."employee" (
  "account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "added_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,

  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "middle_name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("employee_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."encounter" (
  "check_in_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "complaints" text NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "encounter_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "encounter_type" text NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("encounter_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."final_diagnosis" (
  "diagnosis" text NOT NULL,

  "final_diagnosis_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("final_diagnosis_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory" (
  "category_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "inventory_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("inventory_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lab_request" (
  "encounter_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lab_request_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "laboratory_note" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "time_requested" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("lab_request_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lab_test" (
  "lab_request_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lab_test_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "test_name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("lab_test_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lab_test_results" (
  "lab_test_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lab_test_results" uuid NOT NULL,
  "performed_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "performed_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "results" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("lab_test_results")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."medicine" (
  "base_unit" int4 NOT NULL,
  "category_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "form" text NOT NULL,
  "medicine_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "medicine_name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("medicine_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."patient" (
  "added_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "date_of_birth" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "first_name" text NOT NULL,
  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "middle_name" text NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("patient_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prescription" (
  "final_diagnosis_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "prescription_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("prescription_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prescription_item" (
  "dosage" int4 NOT NULL,
  "duration" int4 NOT NULL,
  "frequency" int4 NOT NULL,

  "prescription_item_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("prescription_item_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."receiving_stock" (
  "boxes_received" int4 NOT NULL,

  "supplier_name" text NOT NULL,
  "units_per_box" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("receiving_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."underlying_condition" (

  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "underlying_condition" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("underlying_condition")
)
